sloka: अन्योन्यं जघ्नतुस्तत्र तावुभौ हरिराक्षसौ ।रुधिरोद्गारिणो तौ तु प्रहरैर्जनितश्रमौ ।बभूवतुः सुविक्रान्तावङ्गारकबुधाविव ।। ६.५४.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: anyonyaṁ jaghnatustatra tāvubhau harirākṣasau ।rudhirodgāriṇo tau tu praharairjanitaśramau ।babhūvatuḥ suvikrāntāvaṅgārakabudhāviva ।। 6.54.29 ।।।।

translations.english: Then highly energetic, bull among Vanaras, Angada, uprooting a tree full of many flowers and fruits stood there.
